name: purview-executive-reporting
description: Microsoft Purview Managed Service Executive Reporting Portal — multi-tenant executive & compliance reporting platform.

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); const a = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:api'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const w = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:web'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const stop = () => { a.kill(); w.kill(); process.exit(0); }; process.on('SIGINT', stop); process.on('SIGTERM', stop);"
scripts.build: npm run build:domain && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:domain && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:domain && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
